title: Unified Safe In-context Image Generation in Multimodal Diffusion Transformers via Restricting Unsafe Information Flows
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety mechanisms (UVR) to prevent the generation of NSFW content (nudity, violence) and unauthorized IP characters in multimodal diffusion transformers.
